subject: FW: Vendor update for your AP team
text:
Hey Marcus - not my department but finance asked all the reps to get this to the right person at their accounts. Can you pass it to whoever pays us? See below. Also let me know about the M8 flange bolts when you can, I can hold that price until Friday.

Luis Ferrer
Outside Sales, Acme Fasteners
Cell 330-555-0133

From: Acme Finance <finance@acmefasteners.com>
Sent: Friday, November 6, 2026 3:41 PM
To: Sales-All
Subject: Vendor update for your AP team

Team, please let your accounts know we have consolidated with PNC. Customers should direct remittances to the PNC account from the next cycle. The instruction letter is attached; ask them to confirm with us once it's loaded.

Acme Finance

CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: This e-mail and any attachments are for the exclusive use of the intended recipient(s). If you have received it in error please notify the sender and delete it.
